def process(lightning):
    import pandas as pd
    df = lightning.copy()
    df.columns = [c.replace('*','').strip() for c in df.columns]
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
    num_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c != 'Year']
    for c in num_cols:
        df[c] = (df[c].astype(str)
                    .replace({'nan': pd.NA, 'NaN': pd.NA, 'N/A': pd.NA, 'NA': pd.NA, '': pd.NA})
                    .str.replace(',', '', regex=False))
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')
    df = df.sort_values('Year').reset_index(drop=True)
    return df

def process(lightning) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    df = lightning.copy()
    # remove '*' from column names
    df.columns = [c.replace('*','') for c in df.columns]

    # Parse Year robustly (some file appears to have a bad first row when previously cleaned)
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')

    # convert other columns to numeric
    for c in df.columns:
        if c == 'Year':
            continue
        df[c] = (df[c].astype(str)
                      .replace({'N/A': pd.NA, 'NA': pd.NA, 'nan': pd.NA, 'NaN': pd.NA, '': pd.NA}))
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c].str.replace(',', '', regex=False), errors='coerce')

    # drop rows with missing/non-sensical Year
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Year'])
    df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)

    # keep plausible year range if needed
    df = df[(df['Year'] >= 1900) & (df['Year'] <= 2100)]

    return df.sort_values('Year').reset_index(drop=True)

def process(clean_human, fix_clean_lightning_year):
    import pandas as pd
    # ensure same set/order of columns
    # add missing columns if any
    human = clean_human.copy()
    light = fix_clean_lightning_year.copy()
    # outer merge on Year then sum numeric columns by name
    merged = human.merge(light, on='Year', how='outer', suffixes=('_human','_light'))
    out = pd.DataFrame({'Year': merged['Year']})
    # area columns are those in human except Year; use intersection with light
    area_cols = [c for c in human.columns if c != 'Year']
    # sum human+light per area (Total included)
    for c in area_cols:
        ch = merged.get(f'{c}_human')
        cl = merged.get(f'{c}_light')
        if ch is None and cl is None:
            continue
        out[c] = ch.fillna(0) + cl.fillna(0)
        # if both missing then becomes 0; but we want NA if both NA
        both_na = (ch.isna() if ch is not None else True) & (cl.isna() if cl is not None else True)
        out.loc[both_na, c] = pd.NA
    return out.sort_values('Year').reset_index(drop=True)

def process(total_by_cause_area_year):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    df = total_by_cause_area_year.copy()

    # Melt to long format: one row per (Year, Area)
    long = df.melt(id_vars=['Year'], var_name='Area', value_name='Acres')

    # Drop missing acres
    long = long.dropna(subset=['Acres'])

    # Compute z-score within each Area across years
    stats = long.groupby('Area')['Acres'].agg(['mean', 'std']).reset_index()
    long = long.merge(stats, on='Area', how='left')

    # If std == 0 (shouldn't happen), z becomes NaN
    long['z'] = (long['Acres'] - long['mean']) / long['std'].replace({0: np.nan})
    long['abs_z'] = long['z'].abs()

    # Find maximum absolute z-score
    top = long.sort_values(['abs_z'], ascending=False).head(1)

    # Return area, year, z, acres for inspection
    return top[['Area', 'Year', 'Acres', 'z', 'abs_z', 'mean', 'std']].reset_index(drop=True)
